entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88712. It was for a cycling jersey.
Got it, VF88712. I see the order was delivered 63 days ago. Just to be sure, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's simply the wrong size. I tried it on once and it's just too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping to do an exchange or just return it.
No problem at all. Let me just double-check our policy for that item. One moment.
Okay, thanks for waiting. Since the jersey was delivered within the last 90 days, you're all set for a full refund. I can email you a prepaid return label right now.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I'm going to place a new order for the right size anyway, and I have to go through the trouble of packaging this one up, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next purchase?

I understand the request, but for a standard size-related return like this, I'm not authorized to issue a discount code. However, I have just processed the return authorization. The email with the shipping label and instructions should be in your inbox within the next five minutes.
Understood. Well, it was worth a shot. Thanks for processing the return so quickly.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Alex.
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
